purpose: SSOT of RELATIONS between operator, collaborators, external projects, and toolchains. References by ID (foreign keys); no data duplication. Captures ownership, maintenance, and proof-of-work (PoW) metrics that model real interactions between interconnected systems.
philosophy: Systems are interconnected: physics, culture, and economy obey the same laws of friction. Proof-of-work (PoW) is the real metric that models these interactions. Technology must reconstruct the real from first principles. The sentiment of impasse and social friction are the variables that indicate where technology must act. This registry models those variables as observable, measurable links — not as abstract claims.

rules: This registry is the SSOT of RELATIONS. It references by ID (foreign keys).
No data duplication: collaborator details live in collaborators.json, project details in external-projects.json, toolchain details in registry.json.
A link without a pow_metric is incomplete — every relation must be measurable.
Friction signals (test failures, env-dependencies, boundaries) are first-class data, not noise.
Trust is observed and promoted, never assumed. Promotion requires proof.
The operator (titouan) is the constituent (human sovereign) and maintains all external project governance.
PoW metrics model real interactions between interconnected systems (physics, culture, economy).
